digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review evidence classification
propositions: The canonical AC qualifier tag must be renamed from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] while retaining [operator-attested] as an undocumented backward-compatible alias for 827 immutable event-sourced tickets.

The shared regex matcher must accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] case-insensitively using non-capturing alternation, and all existing tests using [operator-attested] must continue passing unchanged.

The kind wire value in completion verdicts must transition from 'operator-attested' to 'non-codebase', with the reader site widened before emitter changes to prevent misclassification of legacy persisted verdicts.
The .rebar/criteria_routing.json activation trigger and all recognition-side prompts must be widened to fire on both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] spellings.
Author-facing documentation including writing-a-passing-plan.md, coach_moves.py, and generated criteria guides must emit [non-codebase] only and remove all references to [operator-attested].

Python identifiers and module names must remain unchanged to preserve object identity and keep five files untouched, while integration tests must verify both spellings produce identical outcomes across lint, laundering guard, provenance guard, precheck, and close path.
